description.value:
The following lightsaber modifications are catalogued alphabetically; any listed prerequisite must already be met when you install one, and you may install a modification the same moment you meet its prerequisites.

  • Additional Beam Port: a second beam port grants the double (1d8) property, usable only while wielding the saber two-handed.
  • Adegan Crystal (requires 5th level): +1 to damage rolls with the weapon, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Advanced Blastsaber (requires 15th level and Prototype Blastsaber): as an action you can disable one electronic device within 5 feet that isn't worn or held by another creature, leaving it disabled until rebooted. Additionally, activating the blastsaber conversion lets you conjure a 10-foot-radius ion barrier around yourself until the start of your next turn; hostile creatures treat it as difficult terrain, take 3d4 ion damage if they enter it or start their turn there, and any unattended electronics inside are disabled until rebooted.
  • Advanced Brightsaber (requires 15th level and Prototype Brightsaber): while active, its bright light automatically dispels illusions and detects invisibility, as with truesight. Additionally, when you activate the brightsaber conversion and use a bonus action to try blinding your target, that target's save is made with disadvantage.
  • Advanced Disruptorsaber (requires 15th level and Prototype Disruptorsaber): while active, it lightly obscures the area within 5 feet of it. Additionally, when you activate the disruptorsaber conversion and use a bonus action to try knocking your target prone, the next save you make before the end of your next turn has advantage.
  • Barrier (requires 5th level): on your turn, attacking with your modified lightsaber, you may forgo your proficiency bonus on the attack to instead use your reaction to raise a barrier lasting until the start of your next turn, granting you an AC bonus equal to your proficiency bonus against the first attack roll made against you.
  • Beam Gem Lens (requires 5th level): +1 to attack rolls with the weapon, rising to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.
  • Biometric Safety Measures: a security lock in the hilt causes activation attempts by anyone but you to fail; the would-be user must also succeed on a Constitution save or take lightning damage equal to your engineer level and become shocked until the start of its next turn (half damage and no shock on a success), and either way drops your saber.
  • Blastsaber Conversion (incompatible with other conversions): the weapon can make a ranged attack (range 30/60) dealing 1d6 energy damage, and on your first attack each turn you may alter its properties so its damage type becomes ion until the start of your next turn. Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Brightsaber Conversion (incompatible with other conversions): while active, the blade sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for a further 20 feet, and on your first attack each turn you may alter its properties so its damage type becomes fire until the start of your next turn. Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Burn Through: a critical hit grants advantage on your next attack roll against that creature.
  • Comfortable Handle: the hilt's ergonomics grant the weapon the finesse property.
  • Crossguard: an energy guard grants +1 AC against melee weapon attacks while wielding the saber.
  • Disruptorsaber Conversion (incompatible with other conversions): the blade glows sickly green and loses the luminous property; on your first attack each turn you may alter its properties so its damage type becomes acid until the start of your next turn. Usable a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum one), all restored after a short or long rest.
  • Extended Beam: focusing amplifiers grant the weapon the reach property.
  • Greatsaber Array: the weapon gains the two-handed property and its damage die increases to 1d12.
  • Intense Beam (requires 11th level and Burn Through): the weapon's critical hit range widens by 1.
  • Magnetic-Lock Grip: magnetically charged grips grant advantage on checks and saves made to disarm you or resist being disarmed while wielding the saber.
  • Prototype Blastsaber (requires 7th level and Blastsaber Conversion): when you activate the blastsaber conversion, you may use a bonus action to release a burst of energy; every creature other than you within 5 feet of the target must succeed on a Dexterity save or take ion damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.
  • Prototype Brightsaber (requires 7th level and Brightsaber Conversion): when you activate the brightsaber conversion, you may use a bonus action to try blinding your target, who must succeed on a Constitution save or be blinded.
  • Prototype Disruptorsaber (requires 7th level and Disruptorsaber Conversion): when you activate the disruptorsaber conversion, you may use a bonus action to try knocking your target prone, who must succeed on a Strength save or fall prone.
  • Returning Weapon: a retractable chain in the hilt grants the thrown property (range 20/60), and the weapon flies back to your hand immediately after being thrown.
